text:
lina-csm: Heads up — we've had 3 leads this week claim 'SI partner' via intake but no owner assigned. Need a clear handoff + automation. Can we decide rules for claim vs. route? Example: marketplace deals => partner-led, enterprise > $100k => AE-led. Thoughts?

tom-sales: +1. Quick proposal: 1) Marketplace-originated (AWS/GCP/Azure) -> auto-assign to partner PM 2) SI-intro warm leads -> AE + SI (co-owned) 3) ACV > $200k -> sales-led, SI as delivery. Also we need a HubSpot field `si_claim` and an owner tag for automation.

anna-partnerops: We can build a HubSpot workflow to set that property and fire a webhook to the partner-claim service. Who owns the webhook endpoint? @eng-platform or @deploy-bot?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: webhook-service is under eng-platform. Opened INF-842 to add `/si/claim` endpoint and spec the payload.

kevin-si: From SI side, prefer explicit opt-in. Rule: if intake flag `si_consent = yes` then partners get claim rights. Also need account mapping to avoid duplicate claims when domain matches an existing customer. Here's a minimal mapping example: 

```
account,preferred_owner,claim_threshold
acme.com,atlas-si,0
bigbank.com,redwood-sales,100000
```

lina-csm: Good sample. Two follow-ups: 1) adjudication when >1 partner claims, 2) SLA expectations for partner response.

tom-sales: For adjudication: partnerops handles a 24h adjudication window; if unresolved, AE gets temp-claim. For SLA: partners respond to new claims within 48h for first-touch.

anna-partnerops: I'll draft an adjudication checklist (conflict reasons, revenue split, historical ownership). Also propose an automated 'lock' that prevents multiple simultaneous owners on the same account domain.

pete-legal: Quick legal note — webhook payload must exclude PII and only include contact metadata necessary for routing. Also intake should surface a consent checkbox: 'I consent to share my info with SI partners.' Need to ensure partner access is conditioned on CDA/NDA.

lina-csm: I'll add the consent checkbox to the intake form and update the copy. Draft confluence playbook will live here: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/PRT/pages/si-claim-flow

tom-sales: :thumbsup: I'll schedule a 30m sync tomorrow to finalize the rules and get sign-off. Agenda: HubSpot fields, webhook spec, adjudication SLA, auto-release timer.

kevin-si: One more ask — add an auto-release: if partner claims but no activity (no notes, no outreach) for 7 days, release claim back to pool. That prevents stale holds.

anna-partnerops: Agree. I'll own HubSpot workflow + auto-release cadence and the adjudication checklist. Target: EOD Friday for a first pass.

deploy-bot: INF-842 updated with initial spec and sample payload: https://issues.redwood/inc/INF-842 — cc eng-platform and partnerops.

lina-csm: Thanks all. Action items summarised: anna -> HubSpot workflow & adjudication checklist (EOD Fri); tom -> calendar invite for sync; pete -> updated intake consent language and legal checkbox; kevin -> partner ops contact list & auto-release confirmation; deploy-bot -> follow up on INF-842. I'll assemble the final playbook and post back here when ready. :raised_hands:
